name: pkey_alloc
synopsis: int pkey_alloc(unsigned int flags, unsigned int access_rights);
description: pkey_alloc() allocates a protection key for memory protection and allows it to be used with pkey_mprotect(2). It requires flags to be 0 and specifies access rights to disable operations like data access or writes.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Reserved for future use; must be specified as 0.

parameters.name: access_rights
parameters.description: Zero or more disable operations such as PKEY_DISABLE_ACCESS or PKEY_DISABLE_WRITE to control memory access.

return_value.success: Returns a positive protection key value
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: pkey, flags, or access_rights is invalid.
All protection keys available for the current process have been allocated, or protection keys are not supported.
